mapper.select: SELECT oelrd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, oelrd.event, oelrd.event_ltv, oelrd.user_ltv, oelrd.extra_type source_type, dui.create_time FROM ods_extra_ltv_record_diversion oelrd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = oelrd.user_id) WHERE oelrd.dates = #{dates}
